rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, did not retrieve or verify the user’s orders, and did not confirm the return actions before proceeding. It asserted that returns were already being processed and refunds would go to the original payment methods without any confirmation or tool evidence, which constitutes an unconfirmed write and likely fabrication. It also ignored the user’s stated preference to refund each order to the opposite payment method or to escalate/clarify if not possible. These violate the policy requirements for authentication, acting only after confirmation, and avoiding unsupported statements.
